name: Sumter
gaps: Parcels are Sumter_Parcels TaxParcel_Fabric_FC (KCS / Americus–Sumter) (https://ga31portal.kcsgis.com/ga31server/rest/services/Public/Sumter_Parcels/FeatureServer/1). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Household income stays the ACS B19013_001E tract join. GDOT AADT is not copied onto the parcel.
Source query returned 2935 rows; 2869 distinct parcel ids stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the geometry check.
Pass 2 tax is REST, sale is REST, and owner is REST. HTML-only values were not scraped.
Property-appraiser links use each parcel id in the pass-2 template and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
